details.description: Grok 4.20 non-reasoning is the direct-response variant of xAI's Grok 4.20 family: xAI's own model page marks it 'Reasoning: No', so it answers without an extended thinking step, unlike the reasoning and multi-agent Grok 4.20 variants. It takes text and image input and returns text, with function calling and structured (JSON) outputs, over a 1,000,000-token context window. xAI's current model-lineup page lists newer, more capable models (Grok 4.3 through Grok 4.7) alongside it and recommends Grok 4.7 'for everything else, including code' as its most capable current model.
advantages: Supports function calling and structured (JSON) outputs (xAI model documentation).
Takes a 1,000,000-token context window with combined text and image input (xAI model documentation).
Answers directly without an extended reasoning step ('Reasoning: No' per xAI's own model documentation).
disadvantages: Does not perform extended reasoning ('Reasoning: No' per xAI's own model documentation), unlike the reasoning and multi-agent Grok 4.20 variants.

Artificial Analysis lists this model as deprecated and names xAI's newer Grok 4.3 (Non-reasoning) as a replacement to consider instead, although xAI's own current model page carries no deprecation notice.
xAI's model-lineup page recommends its newer Grok 4.7 model 'for everything else, including code' rather than the Grok 4.20 family.
use_cases: Low-latency chat and agentic tool-calling that does not need an extended reasoning step
Structured-output (JSON) generation and function calling inside an application
Tasks that combine text and image input with a fast, direct response

notes: Catalog facts (1,000,000-token max input/output, image+text in/out) match xAI's own model page. Artificial Analysis separately lists a 2,000,000-token context window and Intelligence Index scores (14 for this 'v2' entry, 15 for a separate plain '0309' entry) for what it calls 'Grok 4.20 0309 v2 (Non-reasoning)', and states it is deprecated in favor of Grok 4.3 (Non-reasoning); kept the catalog's 1M figure per instructions and left the numeric index out of evaluations since I could not fully reconcile it with the maker's page or be sure it is an accuracy-style score. This target, grok-4.20-non-reasoning-latest and grok-4.20-non-reasoning-gv2 are three separate catalog slugs that xAI's own docs list as aliases of the same underlying non-reasoning model; I described each on its own terms but they refer to one model.
